messages:
Maya (ML): quick heads-up — LlamaX-q4 quant canary in eval-ci dropped AP@1 by ~4.2% compared to yesterday. dashboard shows regression only on goldset, prod models unchanged. :grimacing:
Chris: can you paste the run id / link?
Maya (ML): https://dash.redwood/p/eval/llamax/q4 run=2026-03-19T21:14 Z. goldset run 2026-03-19-21:12. CI job passed, thresholds tripped after metric aggregation.
Sam: any infra or model changes in the last 24h?
Maya (ML): only two things: tokenizer v2.2 rolled at 03:00 UTC and a small eval-runner PR that adjusted sample seeding (PR #4523) at 05:30 UTC. model binary + quant config unchanged.
Jeremy: pinging eval-bot to run a quick reproducer with old tokenizer vs new one.
eval-bot: reproducer job queued: https://ci.redwood/repro/3345 — will run both tokenizers against same seed.
Chris: paste a quick example of tokenization difference?
Maya (ML): sure — short example from the failing goldset prompt: 
```
prompt: "Open the following URL: https://example.com/page"
v2.1 tokens -> ["Open"," the"," following"," URL",":"," https"," ://","example",".","com","/","page"]
v2.2 tokens -> ["Open"," the"," following"," URL",":"," https"," ://","example.com/page"]
```
Maya (ML): v2.2 collapses the domain into one token for our tokenizer. that changes token boundary positions and therefore prefix-kv cache hits for these prompts.
Sam: hmm that could matter with quant kernels if KV caching alignment differs. but we'd expect tiny differences, not 4% AP drop.
Jeremy: CI bisect might tell. ci-bot, can you start a bisect across commits touching eval-runner + tokenizer between 2026-03-18..2026-03-19?
ci-bot: bisect started: https://ci.redwood/bs/987 status=running. running pairwise runs with fixed seed and with shuffle.
Nina (Ops): FYI I paused the tokenizer rollout to prod earlier this morning once alerts came in.
ci-bot: bisect results: failure reproduces when eval-runner sampling seed is non-deterministic (shuffle enabled) AND tokenizer=v2.2. runs with v2.1 + shuffle: OK. runs with v2.2 + pinned-seed: small delta (~0.3%). runs with v2.2 + shuffle: large delta (~4%).
Chris: so it's an interaction: tokenizer changed token boundaries -> different prefix lengths -> different batching/prefix-cache behavior under shuffled sample ordering -> quantized kernel numerical path exacerbates small differences -> metric amplifies.
Sam: that makes sense. when the harness shuffles the goldset, some prompts hit cold caches earlier in a batch, changing latency and cache state which with q8 kernels changes output slightly. accumulate over goldset and AP moves.
Maya (ML): tl;dr root cause = harness shuffle + tokenizer token boundary change. quantization amplified the nondeterminism into a measurable quality regression.
Jeremy: proposed remediation: 1) pin eval-runner sample ordering (seed) for all goldset runs immediately, 2) add a regression test that exercises tokenizer variants under both shuffle/pinned modes, 3) revert tokenizer rollout until we validate, or ship a tokenizer compatibility shim that preserves previous token boundaries for affected patterns.
Chris: I support pinning seed as hotfix. Nina, can Ops roll that out to eval-canary now?
Nina (Ops): applying hotfix to eval-runner config (pin_seed=true) across canary and ci workers. will push in 5m and kick new canary.
ci-bot: hotfix deployed to canary. new run queued.
eval-bot: canary run complete — v2.2 + pin_seed yields AP delta ~0.4% (within noise). v2.2 + shuffle yields ~4.1% (regression).
Sam: good signal. we should keep tokenizer rollout paused. Maya, can you check the list of prompts that are sensitive (URLs, path-heavy prompts) and add them to a targeted regression harness?
Maya (ML): on it. I'll produce a targeted ~200 prompt set that reproduces the amplification and add to nightly evals.
Jeremy: I'll open PR to make pin_seed default for goldset runs and add a unit test that fails if token boundaries change without an explicit compatibility flag.
Chris: also add an alert on >1% shift on goldset when tokenizer or runner changes land.
Maya (ML): plan agreed: hold tokenizer, pin seed hotfix rolled to all CI, add targeted regression and test, then either ship tokenizer shim or revert. owners: Maya (regression goldset), Jeremy (runner hotfix + tests), Nina (ops rollout + verification), Sam (quant verification).
Chris: thanks team. will follow up in the release channel once PRs are linked. :thumbsup:
